<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/groups/%7BgroupId%7D';
$ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


    $body = json_encode([
  "name" => "string",
  "description" => "string"
]);
        
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint allows you to edit a group in a single API call. This is the ideal tool for synchronizing your contact list from another system, such as a CRM, an e-commerce platform, or a customer database, ensuring your contacts are always up-to-date.

The documentation in this section contains the core reference information you will need to manage contacts & groups via our API, including required headers, cURL sample & error codes.

Before you start your implementation, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
Content-TypeStringapplication/json
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization

Example request header:
PUT https://api.spryng.nl/v2/groups/{groupId}
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'

sections.title: Request body
sections.content:
You can use the cURL sample provided on the right hand side of this page to directly copy/paste into your chosen integration tool, using the below properties to modify your request as required for your business needs.

Required request body parameters

If a required parameter is not provided, or incorrect, the request will fail. If a parameter is conditional, it is only required for certain channels or is dependent on the desired format of the message.

ParameterTypeDescription
nameStringThe name of the group. Max 500 characters


Optional request body parameters

These parameters are not mandatory within the request body, they are designed to provide you further capability to customise or filter your requests.

ParameterTypeDescription
descriptionStringA description of the group. Max 500 characters

Request body example
{
  "Name": "updated",
  "Description": "updated"
}

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:
The standard responses for this API are listed below. For a full list of possible REST API status codes, please refer to this guide.

Success
200 OK
Success response.
{
    "data": {
        "groupId": "4d27b28b-48ce-40d1-8500-0751986ca623",
        "accountReference": "SPNL0000000",
        "name": "updated",
        "description": "updated",
        "contactsCount": 0,
        "lastUpdatedBy": "907da4a7-bb93-4772-8af4-a95cc59e5a91",
        "createTimestamp": "2024-11-26T08:36:54.578977Z",
        "lastUpdateTimestamp": "2024-11-26T14:36:16.7394716Z"
    }
}

Error codes
400 Bad Request
The server could not understand the request due to incorrect syntax or an incorrect/missing required property i.e. unable to find the requested groupName. You should not repeat the request without modifications.
Response example
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "group_name_empty",
            "errorMessage": "Group name must be provided."
        }
    ]
}

404 Not Found
The groupId provided has an invalid format (wasn't provided as a GUID) or the server was unable to find the groupId requested.
Response example
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "group_not_found",
            "errorMessage": "There is no group with the specified Id."
        }
    ]
}

401 Unauthorized
Indicates that the request has failed due to missing or incorrect authentication information. You can repeat the request with a suitable authorization header.

Response example
{
    "title": "An error occurred while processing the request",
    "status": 401,
    "message": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/groups/4d27b28b-48ce-40d1-8500-0751986ca623' was unauthenticated",
    "errors": {},
    "internalErrors": [
        {
            "message": "Pipeline",
            "metadata": {
                "unauthenticatedError": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/groups/4d27b28b-48ce-40d1-8500-0751986ca623' was unauthenticated"
            }
        }
    ]
}
